name: How do professionals remove kitchen trip hazards?

mainEntity.name: How do professionals remove kitchen trip hazards?

acceptedAnswer.text: Professional trip hazard removal typically involves a thorough assessment of the kitchen to identify all potential risks. Solutions can range from repairing or replacing damaged flooring, leveling uneven subfloors, securing loose rugs, or rerouting electrical cords safely. Our process prioritizes effective and lasting solutions that integrate seamlessly with your existing kitchen design.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professionals identify hazards like damaged flooring or uneven surfaces, then repair, replace, or secure them for safety.
